page.overview:
What is Airship Graveyard?

the High Seraph, and it was that which Folmarv of the Knights Templar ultimately sought.|Locales entry in Final Fantasy Tactics: The Ivalice Chronicles}} The Airship Graveyard , also known as the Graveyard of Airships, is the site of the final battle in Final Fantasy Tactics. It is located in the Necrohol of Mullonde, accessible by a portal within Monastery Vaults in the Orbonne Monastery.

After capturing Alma Beoulve and learning the location of the portal, Folmarv Tengille traveled to the Airship Graveyard to resurrect the leader of the Lucavi, Ultima, using Alma as a host body. His initial efforts were in vain as not enough bloodshed has yet occurred since the original death of Ultima's human host, Saint Ajora Glabados.

Ramza Beoulve soon arrived to rescue his sister. Folmarv decided to sacrifice Ramza to Ultima to initiate the resurrection, and transformed into Hashmal, second-in-command of the Lucavi. While Hashmal proved a powerful opponent, Ramza prevailed and the Lucavi Beast's spell on Alma to keep her asleep began to fail.

Unwilling to accept failure even at the cost of his own life, Hashmal committed suicide, resurrecting Saint Ajora in Alma's body. Alma resisted Ajora and separated from him, reappearing nearby. In a rage, Ajora transformed into Ultima and attacked Ramza, whom she likened to those who had felled her previously. After taking considerable damage, Ultima took on an even more powerful form, yet even this was not enough. Ramza overwhelmed Ultima, and the demon set off a massive explosion that destroyed the ship upon which the battle took place.
